title: live_activity_config
description: Firebase Remote Config parameter (type JSON) read by LiveActivityKit and the Live Activity cron. Every field is optional.

brandName.description: Small tag on the image (large style) or label above the title. Empty hides it.

title.description: Main line. Supports {name} and {order}. Empty hides it.

subtitle.description: Second line. Title and subtitle both empty: the image fills the card.

imageUrl.description: Square image for the small style and the Dynamic Island.

bannerImageUrl.description: Wide image (about 3:1, e.g. 1100x360) for the large style. Falls back to imageUrl.

symbol.description: SF Symbol shown when no image is available.

accentColor.description: Clock icon, labels and progress colour.

showStages.description: false: image card only. true: stage, status, progress and stage countdown.

titlePosition.description: Large style without stages: text under the image, or over it.

showTimer.description: Countdown pill with clock icon on the image card.

timerMinutes.description: Countdown length from when the card starts. Live Activities last at most 8 hours.

contents.description: Rotating cards. Each overrides only the fields it sets.

dismissAfterSeconds.description: How long a finished card stays on screen.

startOnAppClose.description: Demo app only; ignored by LiveActivityKit.

autoAdvanceSeconds.description: Demo app only; ignored by LiveActivityKit.
